truthPolicy: independent frozen truth; no project output backfill
moduleBoundary: simply-supported beam only; one axle group, one direction, static envelope; no fixed-step extrema; shear left/right limits retained

cases.title: 简支梁左支反力影响线
cases.inputs: L=10 m; downward unit moving load; z=[0,2.5,5,7.5,10] m
cases.expected: eta_RA(z)=1-z/L; ordinates=[1,0.75,0.5,0.25,0] dimensionless; zero outside endpoints

cases.title: 指定截面弯矩影响线
cases.inputs: same beam; section a=4 m; z=[0,2,4,7,10] m
cases.expected: eta_M=z(L-a)/L for z<=a; eta_M=a(L-z)/L for z>=a; ordinates=[0,1.2,2.4,1.2,0] m; unique peak=2.4 m at z=4 m; continuous

cases.title: 指定截面剪力影响线
cases.inputs: same beam; section a=4 m; report left-section positive-face shear
cases.expected: eta_V(a-)=-0.4; eta_V(a+)=+0.6; jump=+1.0; eta_V(0)=0 using right segment at left support; eta_V(10)=0; retain both limits

cases.title: 单轴组移动极值
cases.inputs: L=10 m; left-to-right; front axle=100000 N, rear=60000 N, spacing=3 m, downward; dynamicFactor=1.0; target left reaction; partial group outside bridge allowed
cases.expected: RAmax=130000 N at rear z=0 m/front z=3 m; controlling axle rear entering bridge; RAmin=0 N when group fully off bridge; 60000+100000*0.7=130000

cases.title: 反向行进或非对称轴组
cases.inputs: same physical group right-to-left; along travel front=100000 N,rear=60000 N; z_rear=z_front+3 m; front enters right support first
cases.expected: RAmax=142000 N at front 100000 N z=0 m/rear 60000 N z=3 m; controlling axle front at left support; RAmin=0 N; must not reuse 130000 N

cases.title: 动态系数统一放大
cases.expected: same control location rear z=0/front z=3; RAmax=156000 N; RAmin=0; spacing/direction/controlling axle unchanged
cases.tolerance: force absolute 1e-6 N; position 1e-9 m; error code/field exact
